newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST - Taiwan Q1 current account - Reuters Poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Taiwan Q1 current account - Reuters Poll.

text.p: Taiwan's first-quarter current account is likely be a surplus of US$1.045 billion, down from a US$1.793 billion surplus in the first-quarter of 1996, a Reuters Poll of Taiwan economists showed on Monday.
The following table gives institutions' forecasts for Taiwan's first-quarter current account in billions of U.S. dollars. ( ) indicates a deficit, if any.
Current account mainly includes merchandise, services and income balance.
Taiwan in recent years generally has shown a surplus in merchandise and income, but a deficit in services.

Economists said a 28.3 percent year-on-year decline in the first-quarter trade surplus to US$1.817 billion should contribute to a lower current account surplus in the first quarter compared to the year-earlier level.

"The services account has been pretty stable in recent quarters, so a reduced merchandise surplus (in the first quarter) should drag down the current account surplus," said HSBC James Capel economist Stephen Wang.
